detailed_description:
Upload three references to generate a consistent, commercial-ready image series in the Creator Dome silhouette style.

1) Main Character Shot: A hero portrait that defines the overall look—lighting, mood, outerwear silhouette, and the orange cap presence.
2) Character Multi-Angle Reference: A collage/grid showing the same character from multiple angles to keep identity and proportions consistent across different camera views.
3) Product Multi-Angle Reference: Clean product shots of the cap from multiple angles to preserve logo accuracy, cap shape, and material details.

The workflow outputs a curated set of cinematic studio images (dark blue gradient + water/splash atmosphere) with varied camera angles and dynamic compositions, suitable for marketing and brand campaigns.
pricing_details: Price covers one generation run that outputs a curated image set.

parameters.name: subject_main_image
parameters.description: Hero reference of the character wearing the Creator Dome cap. This image sets the overall lighting, mood, outfit silhouette, and visual style.

parameters.name: subject_angle_reference
parameters.description: A multi-view collage/grid of the same character (front/side/back). Used to keep identity, proportions, and cap placement consistent across all generated angles.

parameters.name: product_reference_image
parameters.description: Clean product shots of the Creator Dome cap from multiple angles. Ensures accurate logo, cap shape, and material details in the final images.
